title: Grateful Dead Live at Harpur College on 1970-05-02
lineage: CD > EAC > CD Wave Editor > Flac level 8
source: Gen 4 SBD Cassettes > SonyTC-W320 > Marantz 510 > CD

ai_review.summary: Raw, slightly hissy recording that still delivers a stellar show – highlights include The Weight with Jerry’s pedal steel and an intense Cryptical Return.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about this performance, especially the NRPS set and Jerry Garcia’s pedal‑steel work on The Weight, plus the melt‑down intensity of Cryptical Return and Viola Lee Blues.  The tape is a bit raw – early studio splices of St. Stephen introduce hiss – but the added New Riders material outweighs the sonic imperfections.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical praise and multiple 5‑star reviews boost the rating, while noted hiss and raw source keep it from the top tier.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Early studio splice of St. Stephen introduces noticeable hiss; overall tape is raw with occasional muddiness but captures full set including NRPS.

standout_songs: New Riders of the Purple Sage set
show_quality.setlist_flow: Shows a solid flow with the electric Dead set followed by the NRPS segment; the addition of Jerry’s pedal steel adds a unique, memorable moment.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Pedal‑steel on The Weight and distinct backing vocals praised; overall guitar work described as raw but unforgettable.
